name: SuperGUI
description: Header-only input helpers for microcontrollers: debounced buttons with click-length and double-click detection, accelerated quadrature encoders, and single-touch gestures. Plus a set of LovyanGFX UI controls (input box, spin box, list, combo, menu, tabs, slider, color picker, ...).
keywords: button, debounce, click, encoder, rotary, quadrature, touch, gesture, drag, esp32, rp2040, pico
